post.description: Recorded answer: 500 (server_error). Measured by `apps/api/src/routes/authz-matrix.test.ts`, not asserted by this document. No machine-checked request body: **The handler reads the body by hand** — `input['findingId']`, `input['verdict']` and four siblings, with no Zod schema anywhere on the path. There is nothing to derive a document from, and `DECISION_VERDICTS` in `@automate/db` — the vocabulary the decision store enforces on write — is not consulted either. This null is a finding about the route, not a limitation of this generator: the route that records a verdict has no contract for the verdict.
